# Fixture: colprof 生成 ICC Profile 失败
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS colprof 失败输出
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: colprof -v -qm -D "Display Profile" -al output

# ========== 失败场景 1: 输入文件不存在 ==========
ArgyllCMS colprof - Profile generator
Version 2.2.1

Error: Can't open input file 'output.ti3' - No such file or directory
colprof: Fatal error encountered

# 返回码: 1

# ========== 失败场景 2: 测量数据无效 ==========
ArgyllCMS colprof - Profile generator
Version 2.2.1

Reading measurement data from 'output.ti3' ...
Error: Input file contains no valid measurement data
colprof: Fatal error encountered

# 返回码: 1

# ========== 失败场景 3: 内存不足 ==========
ArgyllCMS colprof - Profile generator
Version 2.2.1

Reading measurement data from 'output.ti3' ...
Loaded 4096 measurement points

Building forward lookup tables ...
Error: Out of memory - cannot allocate lookup table
colprof: Fatal error encountered

# 返回码: 1

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 失败检测:
# - "Error:" 关键词 -> 错误消息
# - "Fatal error encountered" -> 严重错误
# - 返回码 != 0

# 错误类型映射:
# - "Can't open input file" -> 文件不存在
# - "no valid measurement data" -> 数据格式错误
# - "Out of memory" -> 系统资源不足
